pages.title: Herbivore / Carnivore / Omnivore
pages.text: Every animal has a diet:$(br)$(bold)Herbivores$() eat only plants — crops, seeds, hay, apples, sugar.$(br2)$(bold)Carnivores$() eat only meat and fish.$(br2)$(bold)Omnivores$() eat everything.

pages.title: Meat & Fish
pages.text: Meat and fish are detected using vanilla tags plus NeoForge's common 'c:' tags, so modded meat and fish are recognized automatically.
Wolves are carnivores. Feed them raw or cooked meat, or fish.
